correctness.rationale: The first received bit is invariant and bit complementation is an exact channel automorphism. Every leading-zero nine-bit word is among the 256 enumerated vertices. Distinct candidate codewords are compatible exactly when their possible-output sets are disjoint, yielding 2816 edges. The complete 256-variable binary conflict-graph program solved to primal/dual optimum 39, no optimality gap, after replay directly from its standalone source. An independently implemented tuple-based checker confirmed all 78 explicit codewords and 396 mutually disjoint received outputs. The objective is exactly twice the half-channel independence number, giving M(9,1)=78. The finite result relies on correct global MILP solver execution, not an unbounded experimental extrapolation.

originality.rationale: An exact nine-bit code size was not entailed by the closest primary bounds or constructions inspected: the 2018 public manuscript arXiv:1307.7087v2 Table II explicitly retains 64<=M(9,1)<=112, while the present finite computation proves 78. The distinct published codes on related channels, including deletion, grain detection and arbitrary-error Hamming codes, have non-equivalent output sets. Specific 2014 primary text covers several short lengths and constructions without identifying this exact length-nine value in the material inspected. Residual risk is possible earlier unindexed enumeration; failed search is not proof of novelty. Sharov–Roth (2015) is a particularly relevant but incompletely accessible later source and remains explicitly unresolved; its abstract describes constructions, not a claim of an exact 78 optimum.
residual_risks: Unindexed exact finite computer searches, unpublished code tables or alternative terminology could contain the same n=9 result.
Some numerical cells in historical journal tables were not recoverable from full-text extraction, though the newer Table II states a nonexact interval.
The upper bound depends on the global optimality report of a floating-point-backed mixed-integer solver; no machine-independent proof certificate is supplied.

Sharov–Roth 2015 provides constructions up to length 18, but the available author-PDF request timed out and the complete paper could not be compared; an earlier exact nine-bit result in this source remains possible.

value.rationale: The historical table has exact eight-bit cardinality 44 but retains a large nine-bit gap of 64 to 112. An exact finite n=9 optimum and a concrete 78-word code materially resolve that natural first open next-length instance in the same channel and provide a reproducible performance benchmark for magnetic-storage grain errors. This is an exact substantive invariant, not an arbitrary code slice, a tiny numerical gain or just a checker implementation.
